// 在 0.24.1 的导出里跑（见 tests/fixtures/old-user-data/README.md「Nomi 形态（agent-form/）」）：
// 用 0.24.1 自己的 useAgentFormStore（setForm / setFloatRect / setBallPoint，persist version 1）把 Nomi 的形态
// 和浮窗、小球位置落进 localStorage，再把落下来的那串原样写出去。不是手写的形状。
import { mkdirSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'
import path from 'node:path'
import { describe, it, vi } from 'vitest'

const disk = vi.hoisted(() => {
  const map = new Map<string, string>()
  Object.assign(globalThis, {
    localStorage: {
      getItem: (key: string) => (map.has(key) ? map.get(key)! : null),
      setItem: (key: string, value: string) => void map.set(key, value),
      removeItem: (key: string) => void map.delete(key),
      clear: () => void map.clear(),
    },
  })
  return map
})

import { useAgentFormStore, type AgentForm, type AgentFormSurface } from './agentFormStore'

const KEY = 'nomi:shell-agent-form:v1'
const SURFACES: AgentFormSurface[] = ['creation', 'storyboard', 'generation', 'preview']

/** 每份：每页设成什么（缺 = 这一页创作者没动过，保持 0.24.1 的默认）。位置每页不同，迁完逐页对得上才算没串。 */
const CASES: Record<string, Partial<Record<AgentFormSurface, AgentForm>>> = {
  'all-ball': { creation: 'ball', storyboard: 'ball', generation: 'ball', preview: 'ball' },
  'all-float': { creation: 'float', storyboard: 'float', generation: 'float', preview: 'float' },
  'all-dock': { creation: 'dock', storyboard: 'dock', generation: 'dock', preview: 'dock' },
  mixed: { creation: 'ball', storyboard: 'float', generation: 'dock' },
}

describe('zzAgentFormGen', () => {
  it('lands agent forms', () => {
    const out = process.env.V_OUT
    if (!out) throw new Error('V_OUT 没设')
    mkdirSync(out, { recursive: true })
    for (const [name, forms] of Object.entries(CASES)) {
      disk.clear()
      useAgentFormStore.setState(useAgentFormStore.getInitialState(), true)
      SURFACES.forEach((surface, index) => {
        useAgentFormStore.getState().setFloatRect(surface, { x: 40 + index * 10, y: 60 + index * 10, width: 400 + index * 8, height: 520 + index * 8 })
        useAgentFormStore.getState().setBallPoint(surface, { x: 900 + index, y: 640 + index })
        const form = forms[surface]
        if (form) useAgentFormStore.getState().setForm(surface, form)
      })
      writeFileSync(path.join(out, `${name}.json`), `${disk.get(KEY)}\n`)
    }
  })
})
